title: Constant coefficient scalar extension on a site
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and $B$ a commutative ring. Write $\underline B$ for the constant commutative ring sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and forget commutativity to obtain its ring sheaf. For a $B$-module $M$, its associated constant $\underline B$-module is obtained from the constant module presheaf of [def-weil-pbc-strict-perfect-coefficient-package] by module sheafification along the constant-ring sheafification unit; forgetting commutativity preserves the local injectivity and local surjectivity of that unit. For a ring map $f:B\to D$, define constant-coefficient derived scalar extension $D(\underline B)\to D(\underline D)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] as the left derived extension along the induced map of constant commutative ring sheaves, supplied by [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Its left-derived universal property determines it up to canonical natural isomorphism.
